boundaries: All mutation/status results are synthetic Editor fixtures, not live provider or balance acceptance.
Campaign stars receipt rendering uses a validated injected memory model; it does not claim a replayed battle in this slice.
The ten final captures supersede earlier in-session layout drafts, retained as review history. Capture scenario is the review startup scenario; screen records the actual navigated controller.
Plain formation/equipment writes have readback and no automatic retry, not a durable request journal.
The journal stores one unresolved/current action per stable account, not an unbounded transaction history.
Android process death/storage, real identity/provider, signed patch cutover, physical touch, human art and release acceptance remain open.
Account reads form one validated publication group, not a provider database transaction.
Broader gear growth, remaining mode/system screens and final native-resolution art remain subsequent slices.
